title: NIST WebBook: Oxygen is O2, molecular weight 31.9988 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Oxygen as O2, molecular weight 31.9988 amu, CAS 7782-44-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Oxygen, CAS Registry Number 7782-44-7, lists molecular formula O2 and molecular weight 31.9988 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 31.98982923912 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/O2/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
